07:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
A G E N D A
Public input will be allowed on all Agenda items at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered.

City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting of November 11, 2012. (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY)
approve the City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of October 25, 2012.

9.
New and Old Business
A.
Consideration of a request of the La Palma-Cerritos Branch of the American Association of University Women (AAUW) regarding its February 11, 2013 city council candidate forum. (COUNCIL)
1. Review and discuss the information provided in this staff report; and
2. Authorize the City Manager to execute documents, including the Estoppel Certificate and Sublease Recognition, Non-Disturbance and Attornment Agreement, substantially in the form included herein with such changes as the City Manager may deem appropriate, to facilitate, acknowledge and consent to the sublease of the property located at 10861 183rd Street, Cerritos, California, between Townsend Automotive Group and LRJ Automotive.
B.
Consideration of a request of the Artesia-Cerritos Woman's Club regarding its February 19, 2013 City Council candidate forum. (COUNCIL)
C.
Consideration and award of an Annual water mains and appurtenances for repairs and services. (COUNCIL)
